methods.name: DroidBot-GPT
methods.description: GPT-powered UI automation framework for Android that employs a two-step prompting mechanism to handle text box inputs and extracts valid choices from ChatGPT responses.

methods.name: Prompt synthesis
methods.description: Constructs a prompt consisting of the task, GUI elements with provided action choices, an action history sequence to avoid repetition, and output requirements (single choice or typed sentence).

methods.name: GUI description
methods.description: Translates a graphical user interface into natural language by extracting user-visible elements, checking their properties, and generating descriptive text for GPT models.
